name: Lyabi-Hauz
tagline: Historic pool and lively old-town heart
description: The social centre of old Bukhara, built around the Lyabi-Hauz pool and its shady mulberry trees. Madrasas, teahouses and restaurants ring the plaza, making it the most atmospheric and convenient base for exploring the historic core on foot.
bestFor: Travellers wanting the old town's sights and cafes on foot

name: Trading Domes Quarter
description: The maze of streets around the historic trading domes, Toqi Zargaron and Toqi Sarrafon, where craftsmen sell carpets, metalwork and textiles. Guesthouses in restored merchant houses sit among the bazaars, close to the Kalyan minaret and Poi Kalyan complex.
bestFor: Culture lovers wanting bazaars, crafts and monuments nearby

name: Ark Fortress Area
description: The northwestern part of the old city around the Ark, Bukhara's ancient royal fortress, and the Bolo Hauz mosque. It is more open than the bazaar lanes, with the Registan square and museums nearby and a slightly quieter feel in the evenings.
bestFor: History-focused visitors wanting citadel and museums nearby

name: New City and Station Side
tagline: Modern district beyond the old walls
description: The Soviet and modern districts outside the historic centre, toward the wider avenues and services. Hotels, supermarkets and everyday amenities are easier to find here, with lower prices, though the main monuments require a short taxi or walk.
bestFor: Budget or longer stays wanting amenities and cheaper rooms
